decisions.reason: Audio and web conferencing has been commoditised by cloud collaboration platforms since the pandemic, and the firm has little distinctive knowledge to add, so its resources are better used in core network and cloud connectivity.
The metro data centre network builds directly on the firm's owned fibre and carrier-neutral data centre know-how, and it has documented customer adoption the firm can learn from and expand.
Optical spectrum services extend the firm's core fibre engineering capability toward the high-bandwidth future it is targeting, so it can interpret results and keep improving the service.
The number ordering portal combines the firm's software platform and regulatory knowledge in support of real-time provisioning, although it could be folded into a broader customer portal.
Carrier pre-selection is a regulation-driven legacy service in a shrinking market, offers no new learning, and is out of step with the firm's software-defined direction.
Direct voice network connection fits the firm's established enterprise voice infrastructure and remains relevant as SIP and cloud voice links grow, so absorptive capacity is strong.
